variants.name: CUT FLOW
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Deliver ONE square logo concept presentation card for Smart Voice Input, a sophisticated desktop voice dictation app. Reference image role: earlier exploration board, use ONLY its S in column 1 and V in column 4 as starting shape vocabulary; do not include the board or other concepts. The user wants original, fashionable, mature brand marks with carefully considered line rhythm, color and visual occupancy. Layout identical across all six cards: very pale neutral gray full canvas, one large centered straight-on macOS-style rounded-square app tile in the upper middle occupying roughly 72 percent canvas width; tile has a fine edge and soft minimal shadow, no perspective. Beneath it, show a small flat charcoal monochrome rendering of EXACTLY the same foreground symbol, without tile, for silhouette assessment. For a dark tile concept the monochrome sample is still dark ink on pale background. Bottom centered small elegant sans-serif identification text ONLY as specified. Excellent professional vector-friendly geometry, optical centering and broad robust forms that can survive small sizes. No microphones, sparkle, robot, sound-wave garnish, extra letters, decorative elements, texture, watermark, elaborate 3D or brand wordmark. Do not imitate an existing company logo. The main mark is the only foreground object on its tile. Concept brief: Refine the S from reference column 1 into a compact, confidently drawn single solid S-shaped sound ribbon. Tight waist with two generous open concave cutouts, rhythmic smoothly changing thickness with no hairlines. Top and bottom terminals share a distinctive approximately 25-degree oblique cut, with tiny softened corners. Slight forward energy, not a lightning bolt or dollar sign. Single rich electric cobalt #2455F5, nearly flat color, on porcelain white. Foreground bounding box target 60 percent of tile width and 68 percent of tile height. Strongest emphasis on memorable silhouette and precise negative space. Bottom label text exactly: 'S1 / CUT FLOW'.

variants.revision_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit target: supplied V3 presentation card. Keep the square canvas, pale gray presentation background, porcelain app tile, gentle tile shadow, overall layout, small monochrome sample position and exact bottom label 'V3 / SCULPT VOICE'. CHANGE ONLY THE FOREGROUND LOGO SHAPE in both the large icon and matching monochrome sample. The current two swooping petal strokes are too close to another option. Replace them with a distinctly different custom geometric uppercase V monogram: ONE CONNECTED bold compact V built from two broad nearly straight diagonal arms, approximately equal arm lengths with left slightly heavier. Straight flat oblique-cut upper terminals with carefully micro-rounded corners, softly rounded bottom vertex, decisive deep central triangular notch. Width about 62 percent tile width, height about 58 percent tile height. A small asymmetrical inward bevel on ONE inner edge is the distinctive design signature; no extra cutout holes. Graphite black with barely visible satin shading, contour and negative space carry the identity. No additional objects or text.
